text:
alice: FYI — hit a perf regression on the canary last night. p95 stable but p99 up ~18% for gpt4-opti-8k under mixed short/long workload. attaching notes from the run.

ben: Did we change kernel selection recently? I noticed a fallback to matmul-v2 in the canary logs.

alice: yeah looks like the runtime switched kernel path because of chunked seq lengths. also saw KV cache hit rate drop 87% -> 63% during the microburst window which amplified costs. fewer tokens coalesced so we walked into more expensive kernel/dispatches.

chandra: profiler snapshot (top lines):
```
timeline_ms: 0-200
coalesce_wait_ms_p50: 1.1
coalesce_wait_ms_p99: 5.8
kv_hit_rate: 0.63
kernels_invoked: [matmul-v2 x98, matmul-v1 x274, attention-optimized x412]
cpu_spin_ms: 12
```

dave: proposal: adjust continuous batching window params for mixed traffic: micro_batch_interval 0.9ms -> 1.6ms, base_coalesce_delay 0.8ms, jitter_range 0.2-0.9ms (triangular), token_budget_target 256 -> 320 for the high-mix policy. add kernel_affinity: prefer matmul-v1 for >512 token batches to avoid fallback thrash. quick config snippet: 
```
{"policy":"mixed-microburst",
 "micro_batch_interval_ms":"1.6",
 "coalesce_delay_ms":"0.8",
 "coalesce_jitter_ms":"0.2-0.9 (triangular)",
 "token_budget_target":"320",
 "kernel_affinity":"prefer-matmul-v1-for-large-batches"
}
```

ben: sounds good. can we make it per-model or per-route? short-only traffic should remain low-interval (<1.0ms) to keep latency tight. run A/B on canary-3 pool. also add a KV-residency monitor alert (kv_hit_rate < 70% for 2m).

alice: starting canary rollout with mixed-microburst policy on canary-3 now. perf-bot will post summary every 5m.

perf-bot: canary-3 update @eng-runtime — 10m after rollout:
- p50 latency: 9.2ms
- p95 latency: 34.1ms
- p99 latency: 74.6ms (prev: 91.2ms)
- kv_hit_rate: 0.71
- coalesce_tokens_per_batch_avg: 18.3
- kernel_fallback_rate: down 43%

chandra: note — avoid synchronized coalescing. triangular jitter reduces the mass at the extremes vs uniform. also add a damping factor that scales jitter down when queue length spikes so we don't amplify bursts.

dave: I'll open a PR with the config + smoke-run script: `./tools/smoke_run_canary.sh canary-3 mixed-microburst`. @chandra please review the kernel_affinity patch. if green we'll promote to dedicated pools after 6h of stable metrics. :thumbsup:

alice: thanks — will watch dashboards and KV alerts. if p99 creeps back up we rollback.
